infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RevCrew uses your location to discover nearby open rides and share your live GPS position with your riding pack.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RevCrew accesses your photos and videos so you can share ride highlights and crew banners.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RevCrew uses your camera to capture ride photos and videos.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow RevCrew to share your live location with your riding pack and find nearby open rides.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow RevCrew to access your photos and videos to share with the rider community.
